comment: GDHCN is described as a trust layer separate from clinical content. It is not made clear whether the document treats this as foundational DPI, DPI-H, regional infrastructure, or an external trust network used by DPI-H.

public.text: GDHCN is described as a trust layer separate from clinical content. It is not made clear whether the document treats this as foundational DPI, DPI-H, regional infrastructure, or an external trust network used by DPI-H.
public.suggestedRevision: Explicitly classify GDHCN as an external or cross-border trust network that DPI-H can use, and distinguish it from domestic foundational identity and trust infrastructure.
